title: New Austin Mayor & Pro Tem
summary:
*   Newly elected Mayor Will Wynn and Council Members Alvarez, McCracken, and Thomas were officially sworn into office.
*   Council Member Jackie Goodman was selected and appointed as the new Mayor Pro Tem.
*   The new Mayor and Council Members delivered individual remarks following their oath of office.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
MONDAY, JUNE 16, 2003
INVOCATION - Pastor Ricky Poe
Presentation of Colors by the Austin Fire Department Honor Guard
Pledge of Allegiance
National Anthem - Diane Yoder
1. Administer the Oath of Office to the newly elected Mayor, Council Members for Place Two,
Place Five, and Place Six of the City Council.
The Honorable Judge Flowers administered the oath of office to Council Members
Alvarez, McCracken, Thomas, and Mayor Wynn.
Mayor Wynn called the meeting to order at 6:15 p.m.
2. Selection of Mayor Pro Tern
A motion was made to appoint Council Member Jackie Goodman as Mayor Pro Tern on
Council Member Dunkerley's motion, Council Member Thomas' second on a 7-0 vote.
Mayor Wynn, Council Member Alvarez, McCracken, and Thomas delivered individual
remarks.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 7:03 p.m. was approved on Mayor Pro Tern
Goodman's motion, Council Member Slusher's second on a 7-0 vote.
BENEDICTION - Father Case
